lcc_original: 那地的金子很好：那裏有紅玉和水蒼玉【7】。
unv_sn_reference: 並且那<WH01931>地<WH0776>的金子<WH02091>是好的<WH02896>；在那裡<WAH08033>又有珍珠<WH0916>和紅瑪瑙<WH07718><WH068>。
notes: 並且 (UNV opening conjunction) is absent in LCC; it carried no SN in UNV so no loss.
LCC 很好 (predicate adjective) maps to UNV 是好的 for WH02896 (טוֹב, good) — straightforward.

Gem alignment by word order: LCC 紅玉 ← UNV 珍珠 (WH0916, בְּדֹלַח bdellium); LCC 水蒼玉 ← UNV 紅瑪瑙 (WH07718 שֹׁהַם + WH068 אֶבֶן). Both versions diverge in gem identification but the positional order is preserved, so the mapping is reliable.
Footnote marker 【7】 kept after the SN tags on 水蒼玉, preserving its original attachment to that word.
